reviews.summary: Assessed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. Configuration discovery, migration boundaries, Semantic Delta identity and generated guidance have substantial passing coverage: 520 tests across 21 files passed, and TypeScript checking passed. Four contract violations remain. HEAD stayed unchanged and the worktree remained clean throughout assessment.
findings: CRITICAL — Synchronization overwrites same-name user files without ownership evidence. src/core/templates/sync-engine.ts:265-279 unconditionally replaces workflow SKILL.md and removes its references directory; lines 395-414 similarly replace internal Agent files. An independent temporary-project probe populated .pi/skills/xirang-explore/SKILL.md and .pi/agents/xirang-reviewer.md with user instructions and no managed marker; syncOne overwrote both without error. This violates .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/agent-workbench-projection.md:25-45 and elements/internal-subagent-generation.md:23-29,47-49. The existing test at test/core/templates/sync-engine.test.ts:415-430 actually expects an unmarked same-name Agent file to be overwritten. Establish ownership before replacement or recursive removal, and replace that contradictory assertion with user-file preservation coverage.

CRITICAL — An unsupported schema discards independently valid configuration. src/core/project-config.ts:275-282 returns null for any unsupported nonempty schema string, before processing context, isolation and other fields. With configVersion: 1, schema: invalid, context: Keep my background and apply.defaultIsolation: worktree, the independent probe returned only default architecture and empty rules; valid version, context and isolation disappeared. check then labels those missing values explicit/checkable at src/core/config-check.ts:76-82. This violates the field-level preservation commitment in .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/project-config-management.md:29 and elements/project-config-loading.md:21-25,49. Reject the schema field while retaining and inspecting independent valid fields, with regression coverage for this combination.

CRITICAL — Strict checking treats unknown nested Git fields as warning-only retired inputs. src/core/config-fields.ts:30-33 retires entire git.archive and git.merge.commitMessage parents; src/core/config-check.ts:26-32 recursively downgrades every descendant to a warning. Independent probes of git.archive.typo and git.merge.commitMessage.typo produced only IGNORED_CONFIG warnings, so an otherwise valid project passes check. The specified retired Git inputs are the particular paths listed in .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/project-config-loading.md:67; unknown nested fields must fail under elements/config-command.md:31,55-59. Narrow the ignored paths and distinguish necessary legacy containers from unrecognized descendants; add a test asserting error status for nested typos.

CRITICAL — Global defaults still include project development policies, contrary to the target global configuration contract. src/core/global-config.ts:19-24 injects apply.defaultIsolation into fresh global reads; src/core/config-schema.ts:50-85 injects both apply and git into schema/reset defaults and recognizes their management paths at lines 115-146. Independent execution confirmed fresh reads return featureFlags plus apply, while reset/schema defaults also return Git policy. The target explicitly places project preferences in project configuration and defines the global default as featureFlags: {} at .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/global-config.md:15-21. Align the global defaults and recognized fields with that contract while preserving ordinary unknown user settings; update the tests that currently require the obsolete defaults.

reviews.summary: 已独立审查完整累计 Change 的 Completeness、Correctness、Coherence 和 Cleanliness，覆盖 G1–G8、四项 Required Corrections、全部 Semantic Delta 与相关已提交实现及测试。发现三项 CRITICAL：CRLF Agent 文件刷新会丢失用户模型设置；配置检查与有效查询的默认值不一致；非法 schema 会遗漏可独立检查的规则错误。审查前后 HEAD 相同，工作区保持干净。
findings: CRITICAL — G6/G7：CRLF Markdown Agent 刷新会删除用户 model。src/core/templates/sync-engine.ts:451–461 在所有权检查时将 CRLF 归一化，因此接受该受管文件；但 :336–350 的 extractUserModel 只匹配 LF frontmatter，随后 :463–476 未提取到 model 就覆盖文件。对已提交 writeSubagents 的内存执行确认：带合法受管 metadata 和 model: "my-windows-model" 的 CRLF 文件被刷新，written=1，模型设置消失。这违反 .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/internal-subagent-generation.md:21–29、39–41 的模型保留及跨平台承诺。test/core/templates/sync-engine.test.ts:463–490 的模型保留案例仅使用 LF；需要统一换行处理并覆盖 CRLF 刷新。

CRITICAL — G2/G5 及“检查报告与实际有效值一致”Required Correction：check 单独补出未进入共享有效配置的默认值。src/core/config-check.ts:82–88 在 normalized effective 缺少字段时调用 fieldDefault；src/core/config-projection.ts:124–128 则在 apply 缺失时省略整个节点。对 configVersion: 1、schema: semantic-model 的已提交源码探针确认：check.fields 将 apply.defaultIsolation 报为 value=ask、source=default，但 check.effective 和 config project 使用的共享结果均没有 apply，选择 apply 会得到空结果。非法隔离值也只显示 ignored，没有说明约定的默认策略。这违反 design.md 的 Decision 1“检查读取同一来源值和默认语义，不单独发明回退结果”，以及 project-config-loading Delta:27–29 的默认 ask 承诺。应在共享归一化层统一默认策略，使检查和消费者取得一致结果，并增加组合验证。

CRITICAL — G2 及非法 schema 独立处理的 Required Correction：src/core/config-check.ts:55–63 仅在原始 schema 等于 semantic-model 时检查未知 artifact ID 和空规则字符串。已提交源码探针输入 schema: invalid、rules: {unknown: [Rule], proposal: [""]}，结构化 issues 只返回 schema 错误，遗漏 rules.unknown 和 rules.proposal.0；空字符串是否合法完全可以独立判断，普通读取也已经使用 semantic-model 回退验证规则。该行为违反 config-command Delta:31、57 的独立问题聚合承诺。test/commands/config.test.ts:135–149 只验证非法 schema 时保留 context，未覆盖混合规则错误。应将独立规则内容检查移出 schema 条件，并依据共享解析结果验证可确定的 artifact IDs。

reviews.summary: 已独立审查完整累计 Change 的 Completeness、Correctness、Coherence、Cleanliness，读取 proposal/design/tasks、全部 32 个 Semantic Delta 单元及相关已提交实现。22 个针对性测试文件、541 个测试通过，但发现两个实现缺口和一个验证缺口。审查结束时 HEAD 未变化，工作区和暂存区均为空。
findings: CRITICAL — G6/G7：CRLF 换行使受管 reference 无法刷新。src/core/templates/sync-engine.ts:230、262–286 使用包含 LF 的精确 ownership marker，未像 skill 和 Agent ownership 检查那样归一化 CRLF。临时目录复现：生成 xirang-configuration-edit.md，保留受管标记、修改正文并转为 CRLF，再次同步；同步返回成功，却报告该文件属于用户并保留陈旧正文。这违反 .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/references-home.md:23、47–49 中对已编辑受管 reference 按模板刷新的承诺，以及跨平台交付要求。应让 ownership 标记识别兼容 LF/CRLF，并补充能证明正文确实刷新的回归测试；退役 reference 的标记识别同样需要检查。

CRITICAL — G8：help authoring semantic-delta 没有取得或交付 delta.md 模板。.xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/cli.md:18–20 和 elements/instruction-loader.md:14–19 明确要求 authoring help 使用统一制品的定义及模板。src/commands/help.ts:23–28、52–73 仅取得 definition 和 Relationship Kind 数据，150–175 的文本呈现也没有模板加载或输出。实际执行 help authoring semantic-delta --json，仅返回 file、definition、relationshipDelta、relationshipKinds。test/commands/help.test.ts:97–128 的断言没有覆盖模板，因此通过的测试无法证明该要求。应从 semantic-delta 的 schema/template 来源读取模板，在适用输出中交付，并验证模板内容及加载失败诊断。

CRITICAL — G4：新增配置编辑协议缺少能保护其关键行为的验证。src/core/templates/fragments/configuration-edit.ts:3–9 已写明只读权限、长期/本次范围、模型建议授权、版本保护及修改后重读，但现有测试仅检查文件存在、入口可达和用户文件保留（test/core/templates/sync-engine.test.ts:67–85、415–425）；test/core/templates/propose-template.test.ts:336–346 只检查 common 的使用规则。执行 git grep -n -E 'CONFIGURATION_EDIT_GUIDANCE|lasting preference|temporary request|Ordinary preference edits|read-only role remains|Reload the relevant effective|never silently make it permanent' HEAD -- test 返回空结果。删除编辑协议中的关键授权或重读条款仍能通过这些检查，无法支持 design.md:146 要求的协议保护及场景/加载轨迹验证。应补充针对关键门禁的验证，并提供长期要求、仅本次要求、模型建议及只读角色场景的实际证据；无需锁定普通散文措辞。

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness. Two targeted verification batches passed (16 files/515 tests and 29 files/304 tests, with overlap), and TypeScript checking passed. One CRITICAL test-evidence gap remains in migration final-validation protection. HEAD remained unchanged and the worktree remained clean.
findings: CRITICAL: The migration test does not exercise final semantic validation. In test/core/project-config.test.ts:131-146, the 'invalid final value' case appends 'unknown: true' during every migration step. On step two this produces duplicate YAML keys, so src/core/config-migration.ts:59-64 rejects the document before reaching final validation at lines 66-68. I independently reproduced the fixture sequence: step one parses successfully; step two reports DUPLICATE_KEY. The broad /invalid/ assertion therefore passes even if final semantic validation is removed. This leaves the required protection in .xirang/changes/configuration-discoverability/elements/project-config-management.md:35-54 without a meaningful owning test, despite design.md:144 explicitly requiring it. Search `git grep -n -E 'invalid-result|invalid final|inspectConfigValues|targetVersion:|migrations:' HEAD -- test src/core/config-migration.ts` found no alternative final-validation test. Replace this fixture with a migration chain that remains valid YAML throughout and introduces a semantically invalid field only once; assert an invalid-result diagnostic and unchanged original content/version.
